paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Depth
model_annotation: The plot titled "Prompt Depth vs Accuracy" illustrates the relationship between prompt depth (J) and accuracy (%) for two methods: "mmsd" and "mmsd2". The x-axis, labeled "Prompt Depth (J)", ranges from 0 to 10 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranges from 74 to 81 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 1. The orange dashed line with square markers represents "mmsd", which starts at approximately 80.0% accuracy at J=0, remains relatively stable around 80.0% to 80.2% up to J=7, then increases to a peak of approximately 81.2% at J=9, before dropping to about 80.0% at J=10. The blue solid line with circular markers represents "mmsd2", which begins at approximately 76.5% accuracy at J=0, decreases to a minimum of about 73.8% at J=3, then rises to approximately 77.5% at J=7, plateaus slightly at J=9, and finally declines to around 76.8% at J=10.
